results.evidence: An LLM knows only its training data and can hallucinate. RAG adds a retrieval step so the model uses fresh or private documents. The three steps are retrieve, augment, generate, in that order. Documents are split into chunks, turned into embeddings, and stored in a vector database. RAG gives sourced, up‑to‑date answers without retraining the model. The answer is only as good as the chunks retrieved.
